about: Exile Oracle market research R7. Prices in Divine Orbs. Leagues: Fate of the Vaal (0.4, start 2025-12-12), Runes of Aldur (0.5, 2026-05-29), Forbidden Rites (0.5.5, 2026-09-04). Day 0 = first 24 h on the exchange. Days 0-6 are daily medians; days 10-70 are single sampled hours (12:00 after the day mark); Forbidden Rites days 63-77 are daily medians from the app's own sync. Exchange items only: no unique items. typical_change_pct is the change in DIVINE terms over the phase (median of the leagues in the evidence unless stated; where the evidence quotes a longer window, e.g. d0->d6, the pct follows it, so read the evidence).

patterns.evidence: d2->d6: FotV 102->146, RoA 66->87, FR 107->262 (S1). Playbook div_rate agrees (S3).
d6->d21: FotV 146->339 (peak 403 on d14), RoA 87->235, FR 262->502 (S1). Seller-site snapshots for FR: ~740 on Oct 5 (d31), ~807 Oct 16 (S10).
Peak: FotV d14 (403), RoA d42 (553), FR d42 (709). From peak to the last sample: FotV -25% (302 d70), RoA -32% (375 d70), FR -34% (468 d77) (S1).
Chaos in Div d0->d6: FotV -40% (exception), RoA +51%, FR +173%. Chaos per Div: RoA 26->18, FR 29->10.5 (S1). Web: FR ~20 Chaos/Div Sep 5, 10.8 Oct 5 (S10).
d6->d21: FotV +6%, RoA +68%, FR +42%. In Ex terms a Chaos went 1.9 -> 57 Ex in FR (d0->d14) (S1).

patterns.item_group: Greater Exalted / Greater Jeweller's / Lesser Jeweller's
patterns.evidence: Greater Exalted d0->d21: -93%, -93%, -96%. Greater Jeweller's d0->d14: -99%, -97%, -96% (S1). Already a playbook sell-day-1 item (S3).

patterns.item_group: Low-tier crafting orbs (Transmutation/Augmentation lines, Regal, Alchemy, Chance)
patterns.evidence: Greater Transmutation d0->d42: -99/-98/-97%. Orb of Chance rises for 2-4 days, then -89 to -96% by d42 (S1).
d0->d6: FotV +4%, RoA +84%, FR +62%; d0->d42: FotV -56%, RoA +91%, FR +136% (S1). Holds value in 0.5 leagues.
d0->d21: FotV +27%, RoA +423%, FR +567%; FR reached 12-13 Div by d70-77 (S1).
d0->d28: -85%, -73%, -83% (S1). 0.5 cut Perfect jeweller/exaltation drop rates (S12, low) but the price still fell.
d0->d42: FotV 0.09->24.7 Div (Immured Fury bug in 0.4, S11/S13), RoA 1.6->9.2, FR 3.1->4.9 then 8-9 late. Very patch-sensitive (S1).
Div price d1->d42: FotV 18->1,180, RoA 62->1,250, FR 83->1,700 (20-66x); flat after week 6 (S1).

patterns.item_group: Corruption / sink currency (Architect's Orb, Crystallised Corruption, Vaal Infusers)
patterns.evidence: Architect's d0->d42: 11x, 53x, 67x; Crystallised Corruption 12x, 16x, 45x; Vaal Armourer's Infuser 20x, 15x, 8x (S1).

patterns.item_group: Top crafting omens (Whittling, Light, Sinistral/Dextral Annulment and Erasure)
patterns.evidence: Omen of Sinistral Annulment d1->d6: FotV +88%, RoA +4%, FR +482%; Whittling d0->d6: FotV +171%, RoA -28%, FR +262% (S1).

patterns.item_group: Top crafting omens (Whittling, Light, Sinistral/Dextral Annulment and Erasure)
patterns.evidence: d21->d42: Whittling +427%/+100%/+104%; Light +349%/+9%/-18%, then +130% by d56 in FR. Whittling d0->d42 = 49x / 3x / 15x (S1). Seller sites disagree on whether omens are dear or cheap in week 1 (S9).

patterns.item_group: Weak / niche omens (Liege, Putrefaction, Sinistral Necromancy)

patterns.evidence: d0->d6: 4x, 6x, 26x; FR peaked d6-21 (0.55-0.64 Div) and fell to 0.34 by d77 (S1).
Tacati d0->peak d10: 11x, 8.6x, 3.3x (S1).
Tacati from the d10 peak to d42: -83%, -76%, -58%. The playbook lists it as 'hold' (+752% by d7). Sell by day 10-14 (S1, S3).
Category median d21->d56: FotV +120%, RoA -70%, FR -27% (S1).

patterns.item_group: Delirium liquid emotions (Diluted / low tiers / Ancient Diluted)
patterns.evidence: Diluted Liquid Ire d0->d2: -83%, -54%, -88%; d0->d14 -99/-96/-97%. Delirium category d0->d42 median: -27%, -98%, -95% (S1).
Essences category d0->d42 median: FotV +38%, RoA -90%, FR -89%; Greater Essence of Grounding -93/-98/-97% (S1).

patterns.item_group: Rare essences (Essence of Delirium, Perfect Essence of the Infinite)
patterns.evidence: Essence of Delirium d0->d42: 12x, 8x, 24x; Perfect Essence of the Infinite d0->d42 +92/+543/+476% (S1).
Category median d0->d2: -28%, -25%, -35%; d0->d42: -53% in all three leagues (S1).
Median d21->d56: FotV +220%, RoA +53%, FR +50%. Recovery is concentrated in specific runes, not across the board (S1).

patterns.item_group: Lineage support gems: chase / meta (e.g. Uhtred's Exodus)
patterns.evidence: Uhtred's Exodus d1->d42: FotV 1.1->59 Div, RoA 7->335, FR 14->280 (still 457 at d77). Atziri's Allure FR 0.17->3 (S1).
Category median d0->d2: -30/-37/-41%; d0->d42 median -37/-93/-74%; e.g. Tecrod's Revenge, Arakaali's Lust -95 to -100% (S1).
d0->d6: 3.3x, 7.2x, 4x. After that it differs by league: FotV -77% d6->d56, RoA flat, FR +67% (S1).
Uncut Support (Level 5) d0->d14: -82/-82/-74%; Uncut Skill (Level 18) d0->d42 -96/-99/-95% (S1).

patterns.item_group: Ultimatum pinnacle fragments (Victorious / Deadly / Cowardly Fate)
patterns.evidence: Victorious Fate d0->d42: 42x, 29x, 53x; still rising to d56-70 in FotV/FR (S1).
Refined Sibilant d1->d42: RoA 44x, FR 42x; Refined catalysts week1->week6: +400 to +1,100% (S1). Since 0.5.0 they come only from the Genesis Tree (S4).
FR Breachstone 0.73->2.8 (d42)->4.5 Div (d70); RoA 0.59->0.38 (-36%). Breach Splinter d0->d42: FR 10x, FotV 4.6x, RoA flat (S1).
d0->d42: 19x, 71x, 88x; FR peaked 33 Div at d56 (S1).

Ancient Collarbone d21->d42: FotV +252%, RoA +59%, FR -7%; d0->d42: FotV 52x, FR 6.7x. RoA rose 11x to d14, then fell -88% in a week (13 -> 1.6 Div) after 0.5.3 (Jun 18, RoA d20) let the Vessel of Kulemak drop Ancient bones (S1, S4).
Category median d6->d21: RoA -61%, FR +2%; d0->d42: RoA -63%, FR -56% (S1).

Exalted units per hourly digest, from the peak: FR peak d4, -86% by d42, -98% by d77; RoA peak d21, -65% d42, -93% d70; FotV peak d28, -81% d70. Divine volume peaks later (d21-42). Unit semantics of the digest not documented; use as a relative index (S1).

Examples: RoA Ancient Collarbone -88% in 7 days after 0.5.3 (S1, S4); 0.4.0d Immured Fury fix expected to lower Fracturing (S13, seller); 0.4 temple diminishing returns (Jan 3 2026) cut temple yields from 'hundreds of Div' to ~20 (S6).

strategies.action: Swap spare Exalted Orbs into Divines (and in 0.5-style leagues Chaos) as soon as you have them; keep only the Ex you will spend this week.
strategies.why: Ex lost 53-79% of its Divine value by day 6 and 83-92% by day 28 in all three launches. Chaos gained 50-170% vs Div in week 1 of both 0.5 leagues.

strategies.action: Sell the crash group the same day you loot it: low-tier essences, Diluted/low liquid emotions, Greater/Lesser Jeweller's, Greater Exalted, low-tier runes, weak omens (Liege, Putrefaction), low Uncut Support gems, Preserved Ribs, non-meta lineage gems.
strategies.why: These fell 80-99% in Divine terms by week 2-6 in 3/3 leagues. The day 1-7 list is in playbook.json; this extends it to week 6.

strategies.action: Do NOT sell the appreciating group early unless you need the currency for your farming setup: top crafting omens, Hinekora's Lock, Architect's Orb, Crystallised Corruption, Vaal Infusers, Preserved Cranium, Trialmaster Fates, Refined catalysts, Uncut Spirit gems level 7+, chase lineage gems, Essence of Delirium.
strategies.why: Each rose 5x-90x in Divine terms from day 1 to day 42 in at least 2 of 3 leagues (most in 3/3).

strategies.action: Spend early currency on what speeds up your farming (league-start build, atlas progress, tablets). Don't buy luxury or speculative gear in the first 48 hours.
strategies.why: Unique prices are 'most irrational in the first 72 hours' (S8, low). Fubgun: rush the atlas, sell tradeables at once, play a build that clears pinnacles for 10 Div or less (S14, S15). Inference: early farming speed compounds; a 5x hold return on a few Div is smaller than a faster atlas.

strategies.action: Sell the week-1 spikes into peak demand around days 5-14: common soul cores (Tacati), Uncut Skill Gem (Level 20), Omen of Chaotic Quantity, Orb of Chance (days 2-4).
strategies.why: Tacati peaked on d10 (3-11x day 0) and then lost 58-83% by d42. Uncut Skill 20 rose 3-7x by d6, then fell or went flat in 2 of 3 leagues. Chaotic Quantity peaked d6-21.

strategies.action: Buy the Divine-denominated inputs you'll need later (fragments for bossing, Hinekora's Lock, top omens for your craft) in week 1 rather than week 4+.
strategies.why: Fates, Hinekora's Lock and the top omens went up 20-50x in Div between day 1 and day 42. Buying early is cheaper even after counting the risk.

strategies.action: Bulk-sell and list big items during weeks 2-3, when the exchange is most liquid.
strategies.why: Exalted volume peaked d4-d28 and Divine volume d21-42. By week 6-10 exchange volume is down 65-98% from its peak, so fills get slow and prices thin out.

strategies.action: Run Orb of Annulment and Fracturing as farm targets/sales in weeks 2-3, not late.
strategies.why: Annulment peaked d10-21 (3-6x day 0) and was down 25-66% by week 10. Fracturing is volatile and patch-driven.

strategies.action: Watch every patch for 'now also drops from X' lines. Sell the item before the patch goes live or right after.
strategies.why: 0.5.3 added Ancient bones to the Vessel of Kulemak, and Ancient Collarbone fell 88% within a week (RoA). GGG nerfs strong loops within ~1-2 weeks and doesn't roll back wealth (S6, S16).

strategies.action: Be first to a new or broken-but-legal farm and farm it hard in its first days, then switch.
strategies.why: 0.4 temple farming paid up to hundreds of Div per run until the Jan 3 diminishing-returns change. Early farmers kept their wealth (S6, S5). Gear prices jumped 70-90 -> 200 Div in a day after the temple videos (S5).

strategies.action: Sell held appreciating items between about day 35 and day 60: omens, Hinekora's Lock, Fates, Cranium, chase lineage gems, spirit gems.
strategies.why: Most of these peaked or plateaued around d42-56 and some fell after (FotV Omen of Light 34.5 -> 18.7 Div d56->d70). Liquidity falls fast after week 6.

strategies.action: Late in the league, hold Exalted for spending and Divines for saving; don't over-convert into Divines after about week 6.
strategies.why: Div:Ex fell 25-34% from its peak by the last sample in all three leagues, so Ex recovers some value late.

strategies.action: Spend or convert everything before the league ends. The 1.0 launch is a fresh economy.
strategies.why: End-of-league value doesn't carry to a new league. The 1.0 launch is reported for Dec 11 2026 (S17), not Dec 4.

strategies.action: Flip on the Currency Exchange only on liquid pairs, with tight ratios and small size. The real 'flip' is the time trend (Ex->Div/Chaos early; hold appreciating items to week 5-8).
strategies.why: Maxroll measured flips worth ~10-20% margin per cycle on catalysts in 0.2 (S18). Our hourly digests show ~10% intra-hour ratio ranges on liquid pairs (Chaos/Div, Omen of Light/Div) but the public data has no order book, so the real spread can't be measured. The week-1 Ex->Div trend alone was worth 2-5x.

caveats: Days 10-70 are one hour each: single-hour noise of +-20% is normal on thin items.
The digest volume fields have no documented units; liquidity numbers are a relative index only.
Runes of Aldur days 108-119 come from after Forbidden Rites opened and are thin.
Seller-site numbers (timesaver, iggm, mmogah, aoeah) are low confidence and are used only to cross-check.
Unique items (chase uniques) are not on the exchange, so no curve for them here.
